messages:
maria: Quick experiment on canary: lowered micro-batch interval 5ms->2ms and coalesce delay 8ms->3ms. Enabled small jitter (±1ms). Observed token throughput up (~12%) but p95 latency regressed on short queries. Profile attached.
kevin: Thanks — can you paste the numbers? Also what's token budget target? Did you bump batch size cap?
maria: ```
CONFIG: micro_batch_ms=2 coalesce_ms=3 jitter_ms=1 batch_cap_tokens=1024 policy=prefer-new
before: p50=45ms p95=210ms tps=1200
after:  p50=42ms p95=305ms tps=1350
kv-hit-rate=0.88
cpu% per-gpu +6
```
ash: Hmm p95 increased a lot. Could be scheduling jitter causing more context switches at tail. Are we folding small short responses into big batches that miss caching? What's median tokens per req?
maria: median tokens per req = 12. Small queries spike p95 because they get queued waiting for coalesce_ms window; prefer-new policy pulled newer small queries ahead sometimes, causing starvation? I toggled policy to prefer-oldest and re-ran.
kevin: results?
maria: second run:
```
policy=prefer-oldest micro=2 coalesce=3 jitter=1
p50=44ms p95=220ms tps=1280 kv-hit=0.92
```
danielle: That looks better for tail and KV hits. Suggest trying micro=1ms with coalesce=2ms and jitter 0.5ms but ensure we don't underutilize kernels — some kernels need 4-8 tokens to be efficient.
maria: Good point. Also saw kernel selection flip to int8 path more often after throughput rise — check kernel logs: kernel_selector: selected=fast_matmul_int8 seq_len=16 batch_eff=3
perfbot: Alert: Regression detected on canary vs baseline: p95 +45% on short-queries group. Ticket created INF-4167
kevin: Let's put canary back to prefer-oldest and schedule a longer A/B with token-budget targets: target small_req_budget=128 tokens/sec (per-host) and global budget to 10% of pool. Also add jitter rand(0, jitter_ms) to avoid sync.
maria: Agreed. I'll run grid: micro in [1,2,4] coalesce in [2,3,6] jitter in [0.5,1,2], policy in [prefer-oldest, prefer-new], token_budget [64,128,256]. Will post summarized results.
ash: Nice. Add a probe that logs per-request wait time distribution and KV cache misses per latency bucket.
maria: Will do. thanks :thumbsup:
